basic63_module.expression: 0 if is_married_filing_separately_with_either_spouse_itemizing or is_nonresident_alien_individual or is_estate_trust_common_trust_fund_or_partnership else min(2 * (12000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 3000) if is_joint_return or is_surviving_spouse else (18000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 4400) if is_head_of_household else (12000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 3000), max(500, 250 + earned_income)) if is_c5_dependent else 2 * (12000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 3000) if is_joint_return or is_surviving_spouse else (18000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 4400) if is_head_of_household else (12000 if is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year else 3000)

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer files a joint return for the taxable year.
inputs.name: is_joint_return

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is a surviving spouse under section 2(a).
inputs.name: is_surviving_spouse
inputs.quote: a surviving spouse (as defined in section 2(a))

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is a head of household under section 2(b).
inputs.name: is_head_of_household
inputs.quote: a head of household (as defined in section 2(b))

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxable year begins after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026.
inputs.name: is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year
inputs.quote: a taxable year beginning after December 31, 2017, and before January 1, 2026

inputs.meaning: Whether section 63(c)(5) applies because a section 151 deduction for the individual is allowable to another taxpayer for the relevant year.
inputs.name: is_c5_dependent
inputs.quote: an individual with respect to whom a deduction under section 151 is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins

inputs.meaning: The individual's legally determined earned income in whole dollars, used to calculate the section 63(c)(5)(B) ceiling.
inputs.name: earned_income
inputs.quote: the sum of $250 and such individual's earned income

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is a married individual filing separately and either spouse itemizes deductions.
inputs.name: is_married_filing_separately_with_either_spouse_itemizing
inputs.quote: a married individual filing a separate return where either spouse itemizes deductions

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is legally classified as a nonresident alien individual.
inputs.name: is_nonresident_alien_individual

inputs.meaning: Whether the taxpayer is an estate or trust, common trust fund, or partnership.
inputs.name: is_estate_trust_common_trust_fund_or_partnership
inputs.quote: an estate or trust, common trust fund, or partnership

obligations.name: c6_zero
obligations.quote: the standard deduction shall be zero.

obligations.condition: not is_2018_through_2025_taxable_year and not is_joint_return and not is_surviving_spouse and not is_head_of_household and not is_c5_dependent and not is_married_filing_separately_with_either_spouse_itemizing and not is_nonresident_alien_individual and not is_estate_trust_common_trust_fund_or_partnership
